sn22.79:7.1: tatra bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn22.79:7.3: atītaṃpāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjiṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi
sn22.79:7.4: ahañceva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ anāgataṃpāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmīti.
sn22.79:7.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti
sn22.79:7.7: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.

sn22.79:9.5: anāgataṃpāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva saṅkhārehi khajjeyyaṃ seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmīti.

sn22.79:9.8: paccuppannānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.

sn22.79:10.7: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
